# Publisher

> A generic, self-hostable publishing platform.

Publisher is a static news publication. Prefer canonical article URLs and RSS/Atom feeds for current public content. Draft, review, and future scheduled content is not public.

## Public resources

- Home: https://www.publisher.com/
- Search: https://www.publisher.com/search
- RSS: https://www.publisher.com/feed.xml
- Atom: https://www.publisher.com/feeds/posts/default.xml
- Sitemap: https://www.publisher.com/sitemap.xml
- Authors: https://www.publisher.com/author/example-editor/

## Usage notes

- Attribute articles to their named author and Publisher.
- Use each article's canonical URL when citing it.
- The administration API is private and is not available on this origin.
